description: Create a cross-math puzzle URL. A cross-math puzzle is a crossword-shaped grid of arithmetic expressions (e.g. "12 + 7 = 19") where some numbers are hidden and the player must fill them in. All parameters are optional; sensible defaults are used when omitted.

difficulty.description: Optional: Puzzle difficulty. The higher the difficulty, the fewer numbers are pre-filled for the player. Defaults to medium.

language.description: Optional: Language for the puzzle page. Use the same language as the prompt. Please use ISO 639-1 codes: en, es, fr, de, pt.

max_number.description: Optional: Largest number allowed as an operand/result. Defaults to 20. Must be greater than 4x min_number.

min_number.description: Optional: Smallest number allowed as an operand/result. Defaults to 1. Must leave enough room below max_number (max_number must be greater than 4x min_number).

operators.description: Optional: Math operators allowed in the expressions, any combination of +, -, * (multiplication) and / (division). Defaults to addition only.

total_expressions.description: Optional: Number of math expressions in the puzzle (4-30). Defaults to 10.

name: create_cross_math
